# The gantry bridge: a chrome beam 2.1 m along z (-1.0..1.1), origin at its middle. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Rail --base-color 0.6235 0.7255 1.0000 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name Beam --size 1 --location 0.000 -0.050 0.000
scale 0.140 2.100 0.140
apply --scale
material assign Rail
shade flat
export bridge.glb
